find_nearby_stations.description: List the stations closest to a point, nearest first, with the distance to each and the vehicles standing there. Optionally keep only stations within a radius, or only those with the kind of bike you want.
find_nearby_stations.name: find_nearby_stations

parameters.description: Latitude of the point to search from, in decimal degrees (for example, 46.948 for Bern).
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.name: longitude

parameters.description: Only include stations within this many kilometres of the point. Leave blank to search the whole network and rank by distance.

parameters.description: Only count vehicles of this type. The categories ('ebike', 'bike', 'cargo', 'escooter', 'glider') work everywhere. A specific type name or id (run 'Get availability summary' to see the ones in use) only matches stations that name their individual bikes. Stations with none of the wanted kind are left out.
parameters.name: vehicle_type

parameters.description: Only count e-bikes charged to at least this percentage (0-100). list_stations_with_vehicles.description: List stations together with what is available at each of them, in one request. Narrow by city, network, state, text, vehicle type or battery level. This is the action for anything that spans more than one station.
list_stations_with_vehicles.display_str_template: List PubliBike stations with their vehicles.
list_stations_with_vehicles.name: list_stations_with_vehicles

parameters.description: Only include stations in this city. Matches part of the name, so 'Bern' also finds 'Bern Bümpliz'. Run 'List cities' to see the spellings the network uses. Leave blank for the whole network.
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: Only include stations in this network, by its name or its id. Use 'List networks' to see them. Leave blank for every network.
parameters.name: network

parameters.description: Only include stations whose state matches this id or name (the API publishes both, and the name comes back translated). Only part of the network publishes a state at all, and stations that publish none are left out when this is set. Leave blank for every station.
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Only include stations whose name, address, zip code or city contains this text.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only count vehicles of this type. The categories ('ebike', 'bike', 'cargo', 'escooter', 'glider') work everywhere. A specific type name or id (run 'Get availability summary' to see the ones in use) only matches stations that name their individual bikes. Stations with none of the wanted kind are left out.
parameters.name: vehicle_type

parameters.description: Only count e-bikes charged to at least this percentage (0-100). E-bikes whose charge the API doesn't report are left out, since an unknown charge is no evidence of a charged battery: that's true for most of the network today, where stations publish counts rather than individual bikes.
parameters.name: min_battery_level

parameters.description: Leave out stations that are standing empty. Filtering by vehicle type or battery level already implies this.
parameters.name: only_with_vehicles

parameters.description: Return at most this many stations. Leave blank for every match.
parameters.name: limit

description: Check live bike availability across PubliBike, Switzerland's national bike-sharing network, through its keyless public API: every station's position, address and city; how many bikes, e-bikes, cargo bikes and e-scooters are standing at each; the nearest station to a point, or the nearest bike someone can actually take; and availability totals for a city or the whole network. Covers the PubliBike and Velospot halves of the network in one place. No account or API key required.
